note: The operator-controlled delivery actions, prepared so nothing is improvised at cutover (domain.actions). Values observed read-only on 24 October 2026 (Cloudflare API through the cf CLI, ssh to triton, gh api, HTTPS); credentials are named, never valued. Cloudflare commands use the cf CLI, never Wrangler (operator, 24 October 2026). Checks name the action's artifact by its digest and its file list (--identity, the next-site-SHA256SUMS every classic artifact carries); the candidate moves as classic keeps deploying, so its entry is re-pinned at action time (artifacts.candidate, then re-run render-handover).

preconditions: See the classic publication bead's pre-checks; this runbook only records that the switch follows the candidate-source handover.

redirect: Add a Single Redirect rule in the zone's http_request_dynamic_redirect phase: when http.host eq "names.facemorph.me", 301 to https://facemorph.me/names (no query, no path carried: no result-bearing or two-click URLs).
rollback: Delete the Single Redirect rule for names.facemorph.me.
namesHost.claims: The redirect does not establish inference-free selection: the candidate's picker still synthesizes. What the names host may claim is decided at delivery, after static names.
namesHost.archiveNotice: facemorph-names is archived. names.facemorph.me now opens facemorph.me's names browser, which runs entirely on your device. This repository keeps its history.

mirror.note: models.facemorph.me (Worker facemorph-models over R2 facemorph-runtime-mirror) copies a runtime file it does not hold from https://next.facemorph.me/ on its first GET or HEAD (classic hosting/next-mirror/worker.mjs; the deploy warms every path that way). The dry run therefore never requests the mirror: it lists the bucket read-only and checks each runtime file of every live and rollback artifact is held (a chunked asset by its chunks). Warming the missing ones is the candidate-source-handover precondition. Only the Worker's MIRRORED prefixes are held (classic hosting/next-mirror/worker.mjs); other runtime paths (the notices page) are served from the site only.
